note: Design only. Nothing was heard; every statement about sound is unverified. Paths and the .ogg extension of the new files are ASSUMED: assets/audio/ambient/ and the five new sfx files were not present when this was written. Layer counts include the synthesized sparkle. Pitch values stay inside the 0.94 to 1.06 clamp. Mirrors docs/sound_mapping.md.

round_start.reason: Church bell for the round start. Cut at 2.6 s (file is 5 s, event 2.4 s). Pitch near 1.0 to avoid sourness next to D minor music (unverified).

round_end.reason: Same bell, lower, quieter and shorter so start and end differ. If it sounds the same as round_start, restore the synth bell_fall.

add.variantOf: current move_step sound (file move_step.ogg is missing today, so synth:step)

move_step.reason: Leaves on a graveyard path. A pool of two stops identical repeats. Cooldown stops stacking on fast moves.

impact_ground_heavy.reason: Adds a crack on top of the dull thump. Tagged mid so it does not fill a second low-band slot (unverified). Not for impact_ground (light).

ko.reason: Owner-picked roar stays as the body. Rattle reads as knocked apart and ends inside the 2 s event. zombie_moan rejected for ko: 4 s and a third voice.

shield_place.reason: Chime lands as the shield settles. Narrow pitch so a clear note does not fight the music (unverified).

heal.reason: Requested in the brief. Quieter than shield_place because the harp is already musical. First layer to drop if heal sounds busy; harp and chime may clash in pitch (unverified).

cat_meow.note: Cat is a playable unit; keep rare, quiet, off-centre. Drop if testers read it as the unit speaking.

blockedWindows.name: throw
blockedWindows.closesAfterEvent: matching impact_* event or flight_* loop stop, whichever is later

ambientRules.bedsBus: separate from creature BASE_GAIN, not counted in maxActive
ambientRules.windValue: public wind value divided by the maximum wind; main line supplies the maximum

reject.reason: 5 s is too long for a sprinkle and uses the single long-sound slot; a growl reads as a threat from a playable unit (unverified).
Fits only a match-lost moment. Random play would read as the game laughing mid-turn. No such event exists; a defeat sting already exists. If wanted, add a new event as a layer on the defeat sting.
4 s against a 2 s event and a third voice over the roar. Kept as a rare ambient kind.
A 5 s bell is a punctuation mark; keep it to round start and end.
Ultimates are not designed yet (owner log, section 1).
Two noise beds at once blur the music bed and effects. One at a time.
Throws are the core feedback moment and have their own sounds; extra layers risk muddying them.

askOwnerToPickFromAuditionMore.use: ambient, family animal or weather, very low weight
shield_place body option or lobby accent

askOwnerToPickFromAuditionMore.type: owl hoot or night-bird call (only if present)
askOwnerToPickFromAuditionMore.use: second short animal sound beside crow

unverified: How every sound actually sounds, including loop smoothness of the beds and pitch clash between chime_single and heal_harp.
That the new files, assets/audio/ambient/ and docs/audition/more exist: they were absent in this checkout.
Band tags of the new layers, all volumes, delays and gaps: first guesses.
That the 16-voice cap holds in a busy round.
